work_item: B04 first-seen exact-string group counts for a supplied JSON string table through Core
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

tests_and_route.reason_not_executed: No tests or runtime/ordinary CLI verification were requested or run in this implementation slice; formatting, compilation, lint and build checks only were run.

implemented_route: apps/cli -> Core::run -> input::structured_intent -> Intent::JsonTableGroupCount -> ports::json_table_group_count -> JsonTableGroupCountReport artifact
input_schema: One strict JSON object with exactly columns and rows fields. columns is a unique 1..256 string array; rows is an array of at most 4096 rows, each an array of same-width strings. Duplicate JSON object keys and nonstring values are rejected.
supported_behavior: The selected named column is grouped by exact decoded string equality. Numeric conversion, trimming, case folding and Unicode normalization are not performed.
Groups are ordered by their first source row and include integer counts, zero-based member row indices, and exact source byte ranges/digests for every member cell.
Input bytes, table cells, group evidence and the Core request output budget are bounded; invalid shape, absent columns or limit overflow suspend with typed failures.

acceptance.B04: UNVERIFIED; source implementation and format/check/lint/build evidence only, no test or ordinary-route execution
